reservoir_ep10_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_001.text: The second protected day began on One Thousand One Hundred Eleven. Yue had expected rest to feel like an empty room; instead it contained a dozen small temptations to prove she was no longer tired. The kitchen porter passed with bowls, a clerk looked for a misplaced board, and the curtain cord stuck briefly against its low hook. Yue freed the cord within ordinary reach and left the bowls and board to their actual workers. The body that would carry her later choices did not need another trial disguised as helpfulness.

reservoir_ep10_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_002.text: The protected recovery record paid three coppers for this actual second day from the course's twenty-four-copper line. Together with yesterday's completed day, six had supported the agreed release from ordinary demands. Yue retained this recovery allowance separately for later ordinary living needs after the finite course; she would not describe it as wages for practice she had been told to stop. Her bed and meals remained covered by their own allocation. The distinction let her rest without inventing work to explain why a paid interval could belong to her.

reservoir_exam_recovery.speaker: narrator
reservoir_exam_recovery.text: Deng visited briefly to observe ordinary settling, not to teach another intake sequence. Yue could ground the earned small circuit comfortably at its existing demand. The headache remained absent, and her shoulder retained its old limits. He asked her to speak one sentence about the courtyard before leaving. She described Tian's basket being carried rather than flying. Deng accepted that ordinary attention and closed the visit on time. Her recovery had taken real protected days. Deng would watch the reduced return before allowing another demand, however confidently she described the absence of pain.

reservoir_ep10_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_004.text: Jing brought the embroidered cloth for a short comfortable visit. Yue had left a bean leaf leaning into its neighbor. Jing said her father would disapprove of the spacing, then admitted she liked the two leaves together. They added a small ordinary stem while seated at the low table. Yue stopped when her hand began to feel tired. Leaving the cloth incomplete again hurt less than it had yesterday. Jing folded it away and asked about the mother letter instead of offering another useful task to fill the afternoon.

reservoir_ep10_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_005.text: Yue showed her only the part she wanted to share: the river onion and the account of the three failed conditions. Jing said the drawing had developed an unmistakably suspicious tail. She made no judgment about what Yue's mother should feel. The mother would receive her daughter's actual news and choose her own response. Yue liked having a friend who could laugh at the page without assuming ownership of its household. They discussed whether onions should have ears until the attendant reminded them that ordinary quiet remained a sensible part of recovery.

reservoir_ep10_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_006.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Twelve, the third protected day paid its agreed three coppers after the actual reduced interval. Yue took one short comfortable walk to the public bench, with no practice load and no errands to complete. The child whose boat had been freed recognized her and demanded to know whether she had seen its later voyage. She had not. He supplied a detailed account anyway. By its end the boat had become larger and faster than its visible folded paper. Yue enjoyed the tale without entering its imaginary speed in any record.

reservoir_ep10_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_007.text: At the bench an ordinary worker asked whether she could copy a page of measurements while resting. Yue declined because the protected interval was not a reserve shift waiting to be used. He accepted the answer and took the page to its actual clerk. She had expected the refusal to become socially painful; instead the conversation moved to tomorrow's rain. The simple acceptance made her recognize how often she had supplied the accusation before anybody else did. She returned by the short path while the walk remained comfortable.

reservoir_ep10_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_008.text: The course kitchen made a plain rice bowl that evening instead of broth. The squash-hating candidate considered this an administrative triumph and asked whether the turnip had finally frightened the cook. Yue said the cook had probably purchased rice. Their vegetable council lost some authority under that practical explanation. They drew a small crown on the offended turnip anyway. Yue laughed without a headache and stopped the visit before fatigue. Enjoyment had its real effect on the evening while the protected rest remained necessary and the failed conditions remained failed.

reservoir_ep10_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_009.text: Day One Thousand One Hundred Thirteen brought steady rain. The fourth protected payment made twelve actual coppers recorded across four completed days. Yue stayed indoors while the public path became slick. She watched water gather at the sill and asked the porter for the ordinary cloth meant for that window. Its low placement required no shoulder strain. She wiped the small pool and returned to the chair. The action helped the room. It did not become evidence that she had passed a new load or recovered every lost unit.

reservoir_ep10_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_010.text: Rain made the courtyard voices harder to distinguish. Yue heard Fu arguing with her brother about whose wet coat belonged on which hook. The disagreement ended in laughter and a dropped shoe. She missed being among them, then heard the brother offer to bring the next dry garment inside. Other people could act on ordinary care while she remained behind the curtain. She would not make their competence into a reason to feel abandoned. Later Fu knocked and asked whether a short visit still suited her actual energy.

reservoir_ep10_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_011.text: Fu brought news rather than work: the borrowed garden hoe had returned, its handle scraped but sound. Its owner had accepted the ordinary condition report and asked for a replacement cloth around the grip. Fu's brother had supplied the cloth himself because he had caused the scrape. Yue appreciated the small causal completeness of the story. Nobody's generosity had erased the damaged wrapping. Nobody's anger had made the sound handle unusable. They could repair an ordinary consequence and still eat together afterward, without calling every imperfection a betrayal.

reservoir_ep10_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_012.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Fourteen, Yue completed the fifth protected day and received its three-copper allowance. The headache remained absent; appetite and ordinary sleep were improving. The attendant recorded those actual observations without approving resumed demand. Three protected days still remained in the prescribed interval. Yue asked whether she could rearrange the low papers in her room, and the ordinary comfortable task was permitted. She sorted the family letters by their actual dates rather than by the mood each one left in her.

reservoir_ep10_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_013.text: The older letters contained fears she no longer experienced in quite the same way and costs she could not remove. Her mother's shortened work periods appeared beside jokes about neighbors, kiln smoke and a plum branch. Yue saw how easily an account of irreversible loss could flatten the rest of a living woman. She did not cross out the loss. She put the pages back where the jokes remained visible beside it. Her next visit would need to include the mother's ordinary preferences, rather than arrive as a ceremony announcing the daughter's improvement.

reservoir_ep10_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_014.text: At dusk Tian brought the sharpened knife back to the kitchen on the agreed ordinary return. He stopped at Yue's door to report that the apple seller had accused him of choosing fruit by appearance rather than ripeness. He intended to correct the seller by buying an uglier apple next time. Yue suggested tasting might provide more relevant evidence. Tian said his basket preferred attractive cargo. She told him the basket had forfeited its preferences by attempting flight. The familiar ridiculous argument gave her a brief comfortable place outside examination language.

reservoir_ep10_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_015.text: Day One Thousand One Hundred Fifteen paid the sixth actual protected day. Eighteen of the twenty-four coppers had now supported the reduced interval. Yue slept through the early cart noise and woke at the ordinary breakfast bell. She reported that sleep as an actual improvement in rest, not a passed changed-sleep trial. The latter would require a separate recovered registered condition and independent next-day check. She ate the warm bowl and asked the porter whether the gate squeak had been repaired. It had become a quieter, less ambitious squeak.

reservoir_ep10_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_016.text: Qiu stopped by to discuss the possible family road information now arriving from ordinary carriers. The seasonal public route could be booked in nine travel days each way if its current checks remained accepted. It was shorter than the earlier winter delay because the blocked section had reopened, not because Yue could move faster through qi. The carrier would provide ordinary passage and published sleeping stops. Qiu left the timetable for later consideration. No seat had been reserved, and no family appointment changed merely because the paper reached Yue's room.

reservoir_ep10_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_017.text: Yue wrote the two possible home windows beside that timetable and waited for her mother's current confirmation. An earlier departure would overlap two paid course duties and a specific comparison opportunity. A later one would preserve those duties while missing the cousin's earlier meal. Both could contain an actual home visit if chosen and booked. She liked neither option enough to make the other worthless. The choice would ask which real absence she was prepared to carry, and she would need to hear what each date meant to the mother who would receive her.

reservoir_ep10_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_018.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Sixteen, the seventh protected payment left only three coppers in the eight-day rest line. Yue took the permitted short walk with Jing and found the public bridge empty. The reed had lodged against a different support and no longer tapped. She missed its uneven sound, which she had once found irritating. Jing said the basin would supply another irritation promptly. They watched an ordinary fisherman repairing a net on the dry bank. Neither woman offered to turn the calm morning into a new measure comparison.

reservoir_ep10_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_019.text: Jing explained that the replacement assessment materials had actually arrived and passed ordinary receiving checks. Twelve coppers from the recovery replacement reserve had paid their issued stock. The instrument custody remained hers, and the clean paired sleeves would await a later actual recovered schedule. Yue was relieved to hear the funded replacement had become objects rather than an expected parcel. Then she asked about the embroidered beans. Jing said her father had approved the new stem while maintaining grave reservations about two leaves. The repaired future could wait alongside an imperfect cloth.

reservoir_ep10_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_020.text: That evening Yue began copying the family letter cleanly. She kept the failed conditions, actual ordinary care and ridiculous vegetable drawings. She added the reopened road's possible dates as questions rather than announcements. Her mother would decide whether either window suited the household, including Qiu Fang's already chosen ordinary visits. Yue would not rearrange work her mother had chosen and paid for by assuming the daughter must become the central appointment. She folded the draft and left it until the next dispatch, when the remaining recovery observations could be described accurately.

reservoir_ep10_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_021.text: Day One Thousand One Hundred Seventeen completed the eighth actual protected day. Its three-copper payment exhausted the twenty-four-copper protected-rest line for its stated purpose. The headache had remained absent, ordinary meals and sleep had continued, and no concealed practice load had been added. Yue had not passed a reservoir condition by resting. She had allowed the body carrying her earned small circuit to recover from the failed assessments. The actual return plan would begin with reduced already-earned instruction and retain the ordinary clinical review booked for One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-five.

reservoir_ep10_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_022.text: At the end of that day the attendant asked what Yue had found hardest about the protected interval. Yue answered that the basin had managed without her. The woman laughed gently and said her own son hated the same discovery whenever he caught a fever. Yue asked whether he was cultivated. He was seven and mostly cultivated a talent for hiding spoons. They shared the laugh without turning the comparison into an insult. Wanting to matter had made Yue less willing to rest; she could recognize that habit before obeying it again.

reservoir_ep10_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_023.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Eighteen, Deng began the agreed reduced return with ordinary settling and one short familiar safe sequence. The maximum input remained within the old ceiling, and the stop ended the sequence fully before he discussed its timing. Yue felt eager and treated the eagerness as something to notice rather than permission to add demand. The lesson ended while she remained comfortable. Jing issued no independent reserve number from this ordinary instruction. The next actual comparison would follow its own accepted blank, sample cost and recovered condition.

reservoir_ep10_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_024.text: Deng asked Yue to describe the body she had brought back, rather than the body she hoped recovery had restored. She reported the absent headache, ordinary sleep, unchanged shoulder limitations and a reluctance at the pause where the movement attempt had lagged. He accepted all four observations. They practiced that pause separately without a movement load. The paid recovery had not removed memory. It had made room for an actual return in which fear could be addressed without forcing another failed task simply to prove she had forgotten it.

reservoir_ep10_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_025.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Nineteen, Jing's accepted comparison measured sixty-eight and three quarters before sampling after actual rest and morning activity. The quarter-unit sample left sixty-eight and a half usable. Compatibility measured ninety-one and one quarter percent. The result was a recovered current condition above the last failed-sleep ending, but below the new local criteria. Safe intake during the reduced return supplied recorded input; neither protected sleep nor a clinician's approval had created a fictional larger inventory. Yue read the result and found she could be glad without inflating it.

reservoir_ep10_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_026.text: The pump-village candidate came to the kitchen with an ordinary repair question from his sister. She wanted to know whether a squeaking pump bearing needed immediate replacement or qualified inspection first. He could not answer from a distant letter and admitted it. Yue said her mother would appreciate a daughter who could also write that sentence when necessary. They discussed who in his village held the actual ordinary repair authority. His reply would request that person's inspection, rather than use a newly improved reserve to make a diagnosis across an unread distance.

reservoir_ep10_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_027.text: A family reply arrived on Day One Thousand One Hundred Twenty. Yue recognized the paper's familiar fold before she saw the date. Her mother confirmed both possible home windows from her own household calendar. The earlier visit could share the cousin's meal on One Thousand One Hundred Fifty-four; the later one would find quieter days after that gathering. Qiu Fang's baseline two afternoons in the month remained the mother's own chosen paid arrangement. The mother did not ask Yue to cancel the helper or bring a cure. She asked what ordinary road Yue intended to book.

reservoir_ep10_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_028.text: The letter described the shoulder review's unchanged practical limits and a new low shelf proposed for the kiln-yard room. A local ordinary carpenter had given the mother a price; she was deciding from her own completed work and household budget whether to accept it. Yue could discuss the shelf when visiting, but the daughter had not acquired authority over that decision by offering travel. The plum tree had gained another inch over the wall. The neighbor had responded by hanging a small note on it requesting rent in fruit.

reservoir_ep10_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_029.text: Yue laughed at the tree's unpaid rent and then cried briefly at the familiar shape of her mother's handwriting. The tears did not announce a new diagnosis. She had missed the woman through a difficult week and now had current words from her. She dried the page before the ink blurred and read the visit windows again. Both were real. Neither would return the years the old bargain had taken. What they could change was which conversations and duties happened while the two women were actually in the same room.

reservoir_ep10_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_030.text: Fu found her later and asked whether she wanted to talk about the letter. Yue chose to share the two windows and the plum-tree rent. Fu preferred the earlier cousin meal for entirely selfish reasons: she wanted a vivid story afterward. Yue said she might instead bring a vivid account of a quiet shelf. They laughed, then became serious about the missed course duties. Fu did not tell her family should always win or work should always come first. She asked which absence Yue felt ready to explain honestly to the people affected.

reservoir_ep10_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_031.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-one, Yue sent the completed private reply through the ordinary receiving courier. The dispatch actually cost one copper from her received course wages, leaving eight of the first nine. She described the reopened road as a possible booking and promised to confirm after choosing its window. The reply included the failed conditions, paid recovery and startled river onion. Her mother owed no timed answer to make the examination proceed. Yue watched the sealed letter enter the courier's accepted bag and then returned to the kitchen.

reservoir_ep10_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_032.text: Tian asked whether the river onion had finally obtained employment in correspondence. Yue said it had gone home to meet a plum tree. He considered that an important diplomatic mission and offered to draw a fish for the return page. Yue said the mother might choose not to reply quickly, or at all, if the household was busy. Tian accepted the correction without making his joke disappear. The onion's journey remained amusing even when nobody invented a compulsory receiving conversation at its far end.

reservoir_ep10_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_033.text: The carrier's current terms arrived later that afternoon. Ordinary outward and return passage cost four coppers each. Nine travel days each way required one copper for the actual sleeping stop and one for food each day, thirty-six in total across the eighteen road days. Yue would contribute one copper per actual home day toward her own meals. Her mother had offered an ordinary guest place in the household. A separate three-copper contingency would remain for a real disruption. The earlier four-day home stay required fifty-one reserved; the later five-day stay required fifty-two.

reservoir_ep10_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_034.text: The proposed family reserve came from already completed personal work, not the examination purse. Thirty-seven remained from the grain wages after dispatch and the five-day private gap. If the two later course work dates were actually completed and paid, received course wages would total fifteen before the one-copper private letter, leaving fourteen. The earlier travel contingency guaranteed another three kept separate. Those sources would make at least fifty-four available for a fifty-two-copper ceiling. The protected-recovery allowance stayed reserved for ordinary living after the finite course ended.

reservoir_ep10_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_035.text: The course would hold Yue's modest bed during either actual family absence at its agreed one-copper daily charge. Uneaten course meals would not be billed as if she had remained at the kitchen table. Their one-copper-per-day reserve would return to the source allocation for the actual absence, twenty-two days for the earlier journey or twenty-three for the later. It would not follow her onto the road. Yue's private reserve would pay every actual travel meal. The empty bed could remain hers without creating a second invisible lunch.

reservoir_ep10_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_036.text: Qiu helped her check that distinction once, then refused to discuss the same coins all evening. She wanted to know what Yue hoped to do at home besides report her examination. Yue named the plum tree, the low shelf and the old summer chair. Qiu asked which conversation the cousin's meal made possible that the quieter window would miss. Yue had not considered the cousin as a person in that question. She sat with it for a while before describing their shared childhood habit of inventing names for kiln smoke.

reservoir_ep10_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_037.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-two, Deng observed a reduced familiar sequence and its full release before the next proposed ordinary work day. Yue felt recovered within the old practice demand and described the movement lag without concealing it. The clinician's retained ordinary limits permitted the dry-measure duties if the morning condition remained comfortable. No new load or qi application belonged to that work. Deng did not authorize a bigger reservoir trial as a reward for her willingness to work. The actual ordinary shift and later clinical review would answer their own questions.

reservoir_ep10_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_038.text: Yue slept well and reported her present condition on One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-three. Zhou assigned the first four-hour interval to receiving dry measures at the low table. Tian had returned the date board with the fish still safely below its writing area. A new receiver arrived anxious because he had brought a copied list instead of the signed source. Yue asked which actual person could confirm it and waited for that person to arrive. The pause cost time but prevented the receiver's embarrassment from becoming an unsupported storage charge.

reservoir_ep10_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_039.text: The confirming receiver came before midday and accepted the exact list after checking its ordinary source. One item had changed during loading. Tian copied the supported correction, and Yue repeated it against the actual measure. The anxious man relaxed enough to admit he had tried to avoid returning to his employer for the signature. Yue understood the impulse to spare oneself a difficult conversation. She did not reward it with a fabricated source. The corrected delivery could now proceed without making his employer's later question impossible to answer.

reservoir_ep10_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_040.text: At lunch Zhou asked whether the ordinary shift felt tiring. Yue reported ordinary fatigue without headache or new shoulder pain. They retained the comfortable afternoon low-table duties rather than moving her to heavier carrying because she appeared eager. The second four-hour interval completed the accepted eight-hour equivalent. Its three-copper wage was actually paid after Zhou checked the work source. Course wages had reached twelve in total, eleven after the private dispatch. Yue put the payment away before thinking about the two road windows again.

reservoir_ep10_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_041.text: That evening Fu's brother performed the promised new song in the small garden courtyard. He forgot the middle line and blamed a child who had coughed. The child denied having composed the forgotten line. Yue laughed, then supplied the worst possible rhyme. Fu's brother adopted it immediately and claimed the song had improved. The gathering contained no reservoir comparison. Yue stayed only while comfortable after the ordinary shift and left before fatigue grew. The incomplete song did not need her to remain until it found an authoritative ending.

reservoir_ep10_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_042.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-four, Yue practiced a short familiar stop with Deng and then rested. The safely completed ordinary work had not resolved the changed-temperature drift, movement lag or interrupted-sleep pause. She could feel her wish to combine yesterday's useful wage and good supper into evidence that the examination should now be easier. Deng asked her to distinguish confidence from actual response. She disliked the request and made the distinction anyway. Confidence could help her return to the room; the room still had to measure what happened there.

reservoir_ep10_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_043.text: Jing's ordinary stock shelf now held the actual accepted recovery replacements. Yue noticed one sleeve resting on a different wooden pad and asked why. Jing had changed its low support to prevent rolling during preparation. The adjustment was ordinary, qualified and already checked. It did not change the sampling method or enlarge the permitted task. Yue admired its practical simplicity. Not every improvement needed a new theory of the body. Sometimes an object stayed where it belonged because somebody had placed the proper small block beneath it.

reservoir_ep10_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_044.text: The fourth actual post-failure clinical review occurred on One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-five. Yue reported eight protected days completed, the resolved headache, reduced return practice and the recent ordinary work shift. The clinician found no new tissue injury and retained the shoulder's established range. She permitted continued already-earned practice within the qualified return plan, with separate starting checks before later changed conditions. The appointment cost the last four coppers in the sixteen-copper post-failure clinical line. All four actual reviews had now been delivered and paid from their reserved source.

reservoir_ep10_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_045.text: The separate recovery reserve had completed its stated fifty-two-copper division: sixteen for four actual clinical reviews, twenty-four for eight actual protected days and twelve for actually issued replacement materials. The later formal next-day checks still retained their distinct twelve-copper qualification line. Yue understood the distinction and chose not to copy the whole division into her family letter again. Her mother would want to know that care had happened and what remained difficult. Yue wrote those facts on her private page, then closed the account and went to the public bridge.

reservoir_ep10_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_046.text: At the bridge Liu was mending a torn bread cloth. He said it had failed at an inconvenient moment and deserved a stern lecture. Yue asked whether the lecture had improved the seam. He admitted the needle seemed more relevant. They talked about the family visit windows while he worked. He had once missed a cousin's meal because a real delivery came late, and still regretted the absence without regretting the bread he had delivered. Yue liked the story because it allowed two feelings to survive one actual decision.

reservoir_ep10_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_047.text: Liu's partner arrived to fetch him and inspected the mended seam. She accepted its strength and objected to its uneven appearance, echoing Fu's complaint about the crooked boot knot. Liu accused the whole basin of forming an aesthetic coalition. Yue laughed and said they would need a better song before claiming that title. The partner asked Yue to visit when she returned from whichever family journey she chose. The invitation assumed she might leave and come back without her relationships here being suspended until she produced a certificate.

reservoir_ep10_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_048.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-six, Deng began revised modest practice by separating quantity from response timing. Yue performed the familiar accepted intake sets under the same old breath ceiling, then grounded and released before a low ordinary interruption. He recorded the actual sets without calling their gross input usable storage. Jing would compare the later current inventory independently. Yue found the separation less frustrating now. She could work on timing during a finite lesson and let the next sample answer what the recovered reservoir actually retained afterward.

reservoir_ep10_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_049.text: During one interruption she thought of the changed-sleep stop and released early. Deng did not punish the caution with a larger demand. They paused and discussed the remembered headache, then returned to one smaller familiar sequence only while her condition remained comfortable. The later response improved within the lesson. It was teaching evidence, not a passed qualifying sleep condition. Yue wrote the difference in plain words after the room emptied. Naming the smaller useful result made it easier to keep than an exaggerated claim she would later have to defend.

reservoir_ep10_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_050.text: Jing's father invited the courtyard to inspect the beans on One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-seven. He called it an inspection because he disliked announcing how proud he was. Fu came with her brother, whose song had gained another dubious line. Tian brought the basket and promised it would remain on the ground. Yue touched the rough bean leaves at their ordinary height and asked the father about the wet lower corner. He answered without mentioning pumps. The crop belonged to the life he was presently cultivating, and everybody listened to that life.

reservoir_ep10_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_051.text: The garden inspection ended with a small shared meal paid and prepared by its actual hosts. Yue contributed a little ordinary chopping within her comfortable low range, leaving the higher pot to Fu's brother. Nobody called the division inspirational. Jing's father complained that the onions were uneven and ate them anyway. When Yue described the plum-tree rent note, he said the neighbor should offer a larger basket. Tian immediately looked offended on his own basket's behalf. Their quarrel remained ridiculous until the children began collecting the smallest dropped peas.

reservoir_ep10_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_052.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-eight, the ordinary road receiver confirmed that both proposed carrier departures still had finite available places. Booking would require the actual selected fare and dates. Yue could not hold both indefinitely while waiting for one to become painless. She asked for the acceptance deadline and wrote it beside the timetable. The family choice would be made by One Thousand One Hundred Forty-two after the final proposed wage day. Her mother had confirmed both windows. The remaining question belonged to Yue's accepted duties and wishes.

reservoir_ep10_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_053.text: Qiu helped identify the exact work consequences of the earlier departure. Two eight-hour course duties on One Thousand One Hundred Fifty and Fifty-two would go to a qualified ordinary replacement. Their six-copper wages would be paid to that actual worker rather than to Yue. A specific plateau comparison on the second date could not be repeated during her later absence or treated as a written substitute for attendance. The later departure would let her perform those real duties and hear that comparison, while the cousin's earlier meal would already be over.

reservoir_ep10_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_054.text: Yue asked whether a comparison missed for family could be summarized afterward. Its public permitted result might be read, Qiu said, but that would not reproduce the attended questioning or give Yue authorship of its observation. Yue appreciated the possible summary without pretending it removed the absence. She had seen the difference between arriving in time and honestly receiving a later account. The two road windows now each carried a particular lost opportunity. Nobody needed to make the rejected one foolish in order for the selected one to matter.

reservoir_ep10_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_055.text: That evening she drafted two possible confirmations to her mother and sent neither. One described the earlier arrival and the missed work; the other described the later arrival and missed cousin meal. In both she asked about the shelf instead of announcing she would fix it. She read them aloud quietly and heard which excuses she had tried to hide inside each. She removed the excuses and kept the actual dates. The final choice would still hurt somebody's expectation, including her own, but it could be communicated without false necessity.

reservoir_ep10_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_056.text: On Day One Thousand One Hundred Twenty-nine, Jing's accepted comparison measured sixty-nine and three quarters before its quarter-unit sample. After actual sampling, sixty-nine and a half remained usable. Compatibility measured ninety-one and a half percent. The recovered reduced practice had improved the present inventory, with recorded safe input and actual stops between measurements. It remained below the new local thresholds, and the earlier failed conditions remained unpassed. Yue welcomed the improvement as its measured size. She had not become a different stage merely because she could read the result without tears.

reservoir_ep10_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_057.text: Deng asked whether she wanted to revise the next week's modest teaching plan. Yue chose the existing qualified timing practice with more ordinary pauses, rather than proposing a larger draw. The choice belonged to a safe lesson's permitted details; it did not unlock another physical task. They agreed on a finite set and its stop. Deng's paid instruction schedule still had a boundary, and additional qualified sessions would need a new actual funding decision. Yue was learning to ask for the particular useful work instead of requesting somebody remain available until her uncertainty ended.

reservoir_ep10_058.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_058.text: The final proposed pre-choice course duty occurred on One Thousand One Hundred Thirty. Yue arrived recovered within ordinary limits and joined two four-hour low-table receiving intervals. A misplaced storage label delayed one parcel until its actual owner confirmed the source. Tian entertained the waiting receiver with the basket story only after the correction was underway. Yue repeated the accepted ordinary comparison, completed the remaining duties and received three coppers for the actual eight-hour equivalent. Her first five course work days had now paid fifteen in total, fourteen after the private letter.

reservoir_ep10_059.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_059.text: With those wages actually received, the family travel ceiling had an adequate personal source. Thirty-seven from completed grain work, fourteen net course wages and at least three unspent original travel contingency made fifty-four. Yue reserved fifty-two for the larger possible journey and left at least two uncommitted from those sources. The separately retained protected-recovery allowance remained for later ordinary living needs. Neither the examination meal credits nor Jing's material money entered the fare. Now a chosen departure could become an actual booking instead of a request financed by future hope.

reservoir_ep10_060.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_060.text: That night Yue placed the confirmed timetable beside the mother's reply. The room held a ridiculous fish, a dried petal and several honest failed results in their proper separate places. She had recovered through real paid days, returned to ordinary work and earned the money needed for a possible visit. She still had no stage-eight certificate. Outside, Fu's brother sang the disputed song and forgot a different line. Yue smiled, then turned toward the two dates she would soon choose between, each carrying a different real life she could not duplicate.

reservoir_ep10_061.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_061.text: Before the singing ended, Fu knocked and asked Yue to stop correcting her brother's invented rhyme. Yue had made the correction twice during the meal, thinking the joke still belonged to everybody. Fu said he was now embarrassed rather than entertained. Yue remembered his quiet face after the second correction and admitted she had missed that change. She agreed to apologize without telling him he should have enjoyed the joke. An ordinary friendship could need a correction as real as the swollen measure, and no independent instrument would announce it.

reservoir_ep10_062.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_062.text: Yue found him beneath the courtyard lamp after he had put the song away. She apologized for continuing after his pleasure had ended. He said he had forgotten more words because he expected her next correction. She accepted that consequence without using her difficult week as a defense. Then she asked whether he wanted another audience later or preferred to keep the song private. He chose later, with no corrections until he finished. Yue agreed. The apology created a different future conversation only because his requested condition was actually heard.

reservoir_ep10_063.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_063.text: Fu waited beside the gate, looking relieved and still a little annoyed. Yue thanked her for speaking plainly. Fu said she would rather have an awkward honest minute than spend the next month pretending every laugh had been friendly. They walked the short path back without discussing the examination. Yue knew she could not treat a person as careful merely because that person kept accurate quantities. Attention to another face required its own practice. The friendship remained, with a specific repair she would have to honor when the next song began.

reservoir_ep10_064.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_064.text: In her room Yue added a small note beneath the family drafts: listen before trying to improve the visit. The words were for herself, not a condition her mother had imposed. She had nearly imagined the home journey as another useful intervention, complete with a better shelf and admirable conversation. The mother had offered actual days in a living household. Yue could bring money for her own meals, ordinary hands within their limits, and a willingness to hear when a joke or plan no longer suited its receiver.

reservoir_ep10_065.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep10_065.text: At dawn the courtyard lamp was cold. Fu's brother hummed by the kitchen. Yue greeted him without correcting the unfinished tune, and he nodded. Their agreed difference had begun to exist outside the apology. Yue collected breakfast and folded the two possible confirmations into her private folder. The carrier's deadline approached. Soon one of those letters would carry an actual departure, with its chosen absence.
